reference.configuration: Courageous/Glorious carrier conversion, using the 1930 Glorious yard-plan hull and flight-deck arrangement: a lower forward flying-off deck, two lifts, starboard island and single funnel, and sixteen single 4.7-inch AA positions. Shared geometry aligns both views. The drawing is an original simplified historical reconstruction; small sponson, crane and rigging details are schematic. The catalog scenario conversion dates and aircraft capacities are independent game data.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
